negative_controls.description: PASS -> later FAIL on the same package_digest => STOP_CERTIFICATION_REVOKED (real git fixture).
PASS on SHA A -> FAIL (or BLOCKED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) on sibling SHA B with the same package_digest => STOP_CERTIFICATION_REVOKED.
PASS, contradictory FAIL, later PASS on the same digest => STOP_CONTRADICTORY_CERTIFICATION; FAIL then PASS => the same; only non-positive => STOP_NOT_CERTIFIED.
Merge-based add/add path replacement => STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_VIOLATED, although git log with default simplification sees one add.
Deleted predecessor (truncation) and chain restart after deletion => STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_VIOLATED.
Wrong predecessor digest => STOP_CHAIN_PREDECESSOR_MISMATCH at write and STOP_CHAIN_INTEGRITY_VIOLATED at read.
Modify, delete, delete-and-re-add, rename and evil merge are write-once history violations on real git DAGs.

Covered or runtime input change at the head => not usable (STOP_NOT_CERTIFIED for a new digest); an edited declared layer or an undeclared new amendment => STOP_NOT_CURRENT; KS-B runtime corpus or lockfile change at a merged head => not usable; KS-B absent => STOP_SUBJECT_NOT_PRESENT.
A file under the retired occurrence root => STOP_RETIRED_OCCURRENCE_ROOT_USED.

Record validation: class inconsistency, FAIL presented as PASS, literal outside the closed vocabulary or with REVIEW/NOT/WITHDRAWN, wrong SHA, same tree/wrong commit, wrong tree, digest, pin, missing RUNTIME_INPUT, wrong kind, authority claim, wrong contract, scope without basis or FULL with basis.

Provenance: Unicode homoglyph, lower-case, whitespace, zero-width, full-width and non-hyphen variants are MALFORMED; separator variants are one identity; PROCESS_GOVERNED required; reproduction claim stops.
Closure derivation fails on a dangling reference, an unresolvable import, a missing toolchain root or setup file; a runtime literal in a comment is not an input.

Precedence: reallocating ANY of the 28 topics to either other domain is RED (56 cases); an anchor on another chain or a missing section is RED; each C10 rule is independently load-bearing; every swapped pair of differently-mapped C10 items is RED.
Closed predecessor semantics: extra key, missing key, wrong path, wrong digest, null over an existing chain, non-tip, fork, two roots, orphan, missing predecessor.
A new CURRENT-reliant locus, or a new bare certified locus, is discovered by registry rules 1 and 2 (the discovery can fail).

Store integrity (review B1): a FAIL with a mistyped or foreign subject_kind under the CENSUS directory, a non-JSON entry, a stray file and a gitlink entry make the store INVALID for every kind; duplicate or insertion-order keys (non-canonical bytes) make it INVALID.
Non-positive literals (review B2): realistic FAIL / BLOCKED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE literals outside the vocabulary are recordable; a positive-parsing literal on a non-positive record STOPS.

History hardening (review B3): a shallow clone is STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_UNVERIFIABLE; a replace-graft or an info/grafts file hiding a delete is defeated; a local log.showRoot=false cannot hide a root add; a present path with zero adds is a violation.
Canonical-store freshness (review B4): a FAIL merged into the canonical ref after a consumer branched makes the stale head STOP_ADJUDICATION_STORE_STALE, and REVOKED once merged.

Canonical ancestry (review NEW-1): a FAIL added and then deleted on the canonical ref leaves a tip an older head still contains; ancestry makes that head STOP_ADJUDICATION_STORE_STALE, and merging the canonical ref exposes the delete (STOP_ADJUDICATION_HISTORY_VIOLATED).
Exact bytes (review NEW-2): whitespace around canonical bytes makes the store INVALID; freshness compares real blob ids.
Non-positive literal ending in a positive class (review NEW-3), e.g. CENSUS_PRIMITIVES_RECERT_PASS as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, STOPS.

Conjuncts the review found unpinned: families and members (target and derived), examined tree, meaning, authority_class, contract path, PASS with nonblocking findings, duplicate nonblocking ids, duplicate closures, empty report reference, identity_facts_basis, currency against the latest positive, changed or deleted recorded family member.

mutation_controls.description: Kill matrix: disabling ANY single validation check (W1..W11, R1, R2) lets at least one negative case through; zero survivors; a NOOP check survives (self-test).
Artifact-driven: adding FAIL to positive_classes turns a REVOKED closure CERTIFIED.

Independent textual mutation battery over the interpreter: 67 semantic mutants (history incl. full-history, --cc, merge entries, add counts, modify/delete, replace objects, grafts, log.showRoot, zero adds, shallow clone; revocation incl. contradiction, non-positive, digest vs candidate binding, cross-digest, latest-wins; consumer incl. retired root, store integrity, history gate, read validation of every kind, freshness, currency, latest positive, family members, declared blobs; store entries; chain; closure; provenance; verdict incl. non-positive literals; record conjuncts; precedence; registry rules 1 and 2), canonical ancestry, non-positive literal suffix and exact fixture byte reads, all KILLED; the HARMLESS comment mutant SURVIVES; original byte-identical; no residue. Three EQUIVALENT mutants are documented and not counted: the canonical containment loop (implied by ancestry plus write-once history) and each replace-object defence alone (mutated together as H7).
